author: Mark Atwood
text:
Closing partially-completed. Bead's premise (all 17 #[allow] dead) was incorrect: clippy fires on 15 of 17 today under default settings. The bead's verification command 'cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-server --all-features' shows 0 warnings ONLY because the #[allow] attrs are present — stripping them surfaces 15 firings (Err-variant ~200 bytes, lint threshold 128 bytes).

Action taken: deleted the 2 truly-dead attrs (on check_count_caps which returns Option<SetError> and hierarchy_error which returns plain SetError — neither is a Result type so the lint never fires there).

Left the 15 load-bearing attrs in place. The workspace-canonical fix (Box BackendSetError / shrink SetError) is filed as bd:JMAP-s9xo (P3).

Asymmetry with canonical jmap-mail-server: mail-server fires 0 such warnings because its MemoryBackend uses trait-impl methods (returning Self::Error associated type), and clippy's result_large_err lint behavior differs between inherent fn return types and trait-impl return types. Closing the divergence requires the canonical workspace decision in JMAP-s9xo, not per-crate cleanup.
